name: vscode-vcd-agent
description: VMware Cloud Director assistant as a Copilot Chat participant

chatParticipants.name: vcd
chatParticipants.description: VMware Cloud Director assistant — manage VMs, SSH into hosts, track tasks

languageModelTools.name: vcd-agent_listVms
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Lists all virtual machines in VMware Cloud Director (VCD). Use this when the user asks to list, show, get, or display their VMs, virtual machines, or instances in VCD.

languageModelTools.name: vcd-agent_listVapps
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Lists all vApps in the VCD organization. Use when the user asks about vApps or virtual application containers in VCD.

languageModelTools.name: vcd-agent_listTemplates
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Lists all VM templates available in VMware Cloud Director. Use when the user asks to list or browse VM templates.

languageModelTools.name: vcd-agent_getVmDetails
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Gets detailed information about a specific VM in VCD including CPU, memory, disks, network, and power state. Use when the user asks for details, info, or specs of a named VM.

languageModelTools.name: vcd-agent_checkVmStatus
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Checks the current power state (on/off/suspended) of a VM in VCD. Use when the user asks if a VM is running, powered on, or its status.

languageModelTools.name: vcd-agent_listTasks
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Lists recent VCD tasks (provisioning, power operations, etc.) and their status. Use when user asks about VCD tasks or recent operations.

languageModelTools.name: vcd-agent_powerOnVm
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Powers on a VM in VMware Cloud Director. Use when user asks to start, power on, or boot a VM. Requires user confirmation.

languageModelTools.name: vcd-agent_powerOffVm
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Powers off a VM in VMware Cloud Director. Use when user asks to stop, shut down, or power off a VM. Requires user confirmation.

languageModelTools.name: vcd-agent_deleteVm
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Permanently deletes a VM from VCD. Use when user asks to delete or remove a VM. Requires user confirmation.

languageModelTools.name: vcd-agent_createSnapshot
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Creates a snapshot of a VM in VCD. Use when user asks to snapshot, checkpoint, or save the state of a VM. Requires confirmation.

languageModelTools.name: vcd-agent_revertSnapshot
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Reverts a VM to a previous snapshot in VCD. Use when user asks to revert, restore, or rollback a VM. Requires confirmation.

languageModelTools.name: vcd-agent_listSnapshots
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Lists all snapshots for a VM in VCD. Use when user asks to list or show snapshots of a VM.

languageModelTools.name: vcd-agent_copyVm
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Copies or clones a VM to a new name and vApp in VCD. Use when user asks to copy, clone, or duplicate a VM. Requires confirmation.

languageModelTools.name: vcd-agent_resizeVm
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Changes CPU count or memory allocation of a VM in VCD. Use when user asks to resize, scale, or change CPU/RAM of a VM. Requires confirmation.

languageModelTools.name: vcd-agent_allocateFreeIp
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Allocates a free IP address from the VCD network pool. Use when user asks for a free IP or to allocate a network address. Requires confirmation.

languageModelTools.name: vcd-agent_getContext
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Gets the current active VCD context: organization, vDC, vApp, and network. Use when user asks what VCD org/vDC/vApp is active.

languageModelTools.name: vcd-agent_setContext
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Sets the active VCD organization, vDC, vApp, or network. Use when user wants to switch VCD org/vDC/vApp context. Requires confirmation.

languageModelTools.name: vcd-agent_vmWatch
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Starts monitoring a VM for power-state changes in VCD.

languageModelTools.name: vcd-agent_vmWatchCancel
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Stops monitoring a VM for power-state changes in VCD.

languageModelTools.name: vcd-agent_sshConnect
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Opens an SSH connection to a remote Linux/Unix host by IP or hostname. Use when user asks to SSH into, connect to, or open a terminal on a remote server.

languageModelTools.name: vcd-agent_sshDisconnect
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Closes an SSH session. Use when user asks to disconnect or close an SSH session.

languageModelTools.name: vcd-agent_sshListSessions
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Lists all currently open SSH sessions and their connection details.

languageModelTools.name: vcd-agent_sshRunCommand
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Runs a shell command on a remote host over SSH and returns the output. Use when user asks to run, execute, or check something on a remote server.

languageModelTools.name: vcd-agent_sshRunSudo
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Runs a command with sudo privileges on a remote host via SSH.

languageModelTools.name: vcd-agent_sshRunScript
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Uploads and executes a shell script on a remote host via SSH.

languageModelTools.name: vcd-agent_sshBackground
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Runs a command in the background (nohup) on a remote host via SSH.

languageModelTools.name: vcd-agent_sshKillProcess
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Kills a process by PID on a remote host via SSH.

languageModelTools.name: vcd-agent_sshListProcesses
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Lists running processes on a remote host via SSH.

languageModelTools.name: vcd-agent_sshReadFile
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Reads and returns the content of a file on a remote host via SSH.

languageModelTools.name: vcd-agent_sshWriteFile
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Writes or overwrites a file on a remote host via SSH.

languageModelTools.name: vcd-agent_sshListDir
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Lists files in a directory on a remote host via SSH.

languageModelTools.name: vcd-agent_sshUploadFile
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Uploads a local file to a remote host via SFTP.

languageModelTools.name: vcd-agent_sshDownloadFile
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Downloads a file from a remote host to local machine via SFTP.

languageModelTools.name: vcd-agent_sshDeleteFile
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Deletes a file on a remote host via SSH.

languageModelTools.name: vcd-agent_sshMkdir
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Creates a directory on a remote host via SSH.

languageModelTools.name: vcd-agent_sshFileInfo
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Gets metadata (size, permissions, modified date) of a file on a remote host.

languageModelTools.name: vcd-agent_sshSystemInfo
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Gets CPU, memory, OS, and uptime information from a remote Linux host via SSH.

languageModelTools.name: vcd-agent_sshDiskUsage
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Gets disk usage statistics (df) from a remote host via SSH.

languageModelTools.name: vcd-agent_sshNetworkStatus
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Gets network interfaces and routing info from a remote host via SSH.

languageModelTools.name: vcd-agent_sshCheckService
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Checks if a systemd service is running on a remote host via SSH.

languageModelTools.name: vcd-agent_sshManageService
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Starts, stops, restarts, or reloads a systemd service on a remote host via SSH.

languageModelTools.name: vcd-agent_sshViewLogs
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Views systemd journal logs or tails a log file on a remote host via SSH.

languageModelTools.name: vcd-agent_sshGetEnvVars
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Gets environment variables from a remote host via SSH.

languageModelTools.name: vcd-agent_docsUpload
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Uploads and indexes a PDF, DOCX, or TXT document so it can be searched and queried. Use when user asks to upload, add, or index a document.

languageModelTools.name: vcd-agent_docsStatus
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Checks the processing/indexing status of an uploaded document.

languageModelTools.name: vcd-agent_docsList
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Lists all uploaded and indexed documents. Use when user asks what documents are available.

languageModelTools.name: vcd-agent_docsSearch
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Searches indexed documents for text matching a query. Use when user asks to search or find content in their documents.

languageModelTools.name: vcd-agent_docsAsk
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Answers a question using content from uploaded documents. Use when user asks a question that could be answered by their uploaded documents.

languageModelTools.name: vcd-agent_docsGetContent
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Retrieves the full text of an uploaded document.

languageModelTools.name: vcd-agent_docsDelete
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Deletes an uploaded document and removes it from the search index.

languageModelTools.name: vcd-agent_localReadFile
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Reads the content of a file in the local workspace.

languageModelTools.name: vcd-agent_localListDir
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Lists files and folders in a local workspace directory.

languageModelTools.name: vcd-agent_localCreateFile
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Creates a new file with content in the local workspace.

languageModelTools.name: vcd-agent_localWriteFile
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Overwrites a file in the local workspace with new content.

languageModelTools.name: vcd-agent_localDeleteFile
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Deletes a file from the local workspace.

languageModelTools.name: vcd-agent_localRunCommand
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Executes a shell command in the local workspace directory.

languageModelTools.name: vcd-agent_taskStart
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Creates a new tracked task to monitor a multi-step operation.

languageModelTools.name: vcd-agent_taskLogStep
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Records a completed step with its output under the current task.

languageModelTools.name: vcd-agent_taskDone
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Marks a task as completed with a summary.

languageModelTools.name: vcd-agent_taskList
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Lists recent tracked tasks and their statuses.

languageModelTools.name: vcd-agent_taskCancel
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Cancels a running task.

languageModelTools.name: vcd-agent_taskGetLog
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Retrieves the full output log for a task step.

viewsWelcome.contents:
Not connected to VCD.
[$(plug) Connect to VCD](command:vcdAgent.connect)

---
**Tip — two ways to use VCD Agent in Copilot Chat:**

① **Agent Mode** (recommended) — no prefix needed:
Switch the chat mode dropdown to **Agent** and ask naturally:
> *list my running VMs*
> *power off web-01*

② **@vcd participant** — works in any mode:
> `@vcd list my running VMs`
